options.reason: The table pairs 22 MFCC acoustic features of segmented frog calls with a fine-grained taxonomic label, so the evident study is classifying call to one of the 10 observed species (multiclass); Family and Genus are coarser taxonomic parents derived from the same annotation and would leak the species label, and RecordID must be grouped so calls from one recording never span train and test.
options.title: multiclass
